items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 141:1
items.html: (To the question) Daat is not a new Sefira, but the Tifferet of the smallness becomes Daat at the time of the greatness, for the HGT of the smallness become the KHB of the greatness, as is known. (Item 177).
